Suppose one of the eight lettered identical squares is included with the four squares in the T-shaped figure outlined. How many of the resulting figures can be folded into a topless cubical box?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: All small squares in the picture are equal in size. Four squares without letters form a T shape protruding to the right: in the middle there are three blank squares arranged vertically, and another blank square is attached to the right of the middle square of the vertical column. Eight candidate squares with letters surround this T shape: A is above the topmost blank square of the vertical column, H is below the bottommost blank square of the vertical column; B, D, F are respectively to the left of the upper, middle, and lower three blank squares of the vertical column; C is above the blank square protruding on the right, E is to the right of the blank square protruding on the right, and G is below the blank square protruding on the right. Reasoning: According to the specified method, regard the middle blank square of the vertical column as the bottom face of an open-top cube box. In this way, the upper blank square, lower blank square, and right-side blank square adjacent to it can be folded up to become three side faces, and one side face is still missing. Check the added lettered squares one by one: after folding, A, B, D, E, F, H can supplement the missing fifth face and do not overlap with existing faces; while C and G will fold to coincide with the face direction corresponding to the existing right-side protruding square, causing overlap, and cannot form an open-top box. Therefore there are 6 feasible ways to add.

raw_record.question_text: Suppose one of the eight lettered identical squares is included with the four squares in the T-shaped figure outlined. How many of the resulting figures can be folded into a topless cubical box?

method.method_draft: Read the image as a grid of equal squares: the four unlettered outlined squares form a sideways T, consisting of three squares in a vertical column plus one square attached to the right of the middle column square. The eight possible added squares are positioned around this T: A above the top column square, H below the bottom column square, B/D/F to the left of the three column squares, C above the right arm, E to the right of the right arm, and G below the right arm. Treat the middle column square as the bottom of the topless box and fold adjacent squares up as side faces. The top column square, bottom column square, and right-arm square then become three distinct side faces. For each candidate added square, propagate the fold one more step and check whether it produces the missing fifth face or overlaps an already-used face. A, B, D, E, F, and H fold to the remaining allowable face positions, while C and G would fold onto the same face direction as the existing right-arm square, causing overlap. Therefore 6 additions work.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中所有小方格等大。四个没有字母的方格组成一个向右伸出的 T 形：中间有三个空白方格竖直排列，另有一个空白方格接在竖列中间方格的右边。八个带字母的候选方格围在这个 T 形周围：A 在竖列最上方空格的上面，H 在竖列最下方空格的下面；B、D、F 分别在竖列上、中、下三个空格的左边；C 在右侧伸出空格的上方，E 在右侧伸出空格的右边，G 在右侧伸出空格的下方。
推理：按照指定方法，把竖列中间的空白方格看作无盖立方盒的底面。这样，与它相邻的上方空白方格、下方空白方格和右侧空白方格可以折起成为三个侧面，还缺少一个侧面。逐一检查加入的字母方格：A、B、D、E、F、H 折叠后可以补成缺少的第五个面，不与已有面重合；而 C 和 G 会折到与已有右侧伸出方格对应的面方向重合，造成重叠，不能形成无盖盒。因此可行的加入方式共有 6 个。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is a direct geometric folding/net-validation route using face-orientation propagation from the fixed T-shaped four-square base.
planner_metadata.image_role: The image supplies the exact adjacency layout of the four unlettered T-shape squares and the eight candidate lettered squares A through H around it.
planner_metadata.text_role: The text specifies that exactly one of the eight lettered squares is added and asks how many resulting five-square figures fold into a topless cubical box.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the cube-net rule that a valid topless cubical box net must fold to five distinct cube faces with no two squares occupying the same face direction.
